question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be done in place after place
The object of meditation extends from Shiva downward
Its range reaches as far as Avici
inference: One should meditate in every place on that which pervades from Shiva down to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated in every place on that which extends from Shiva down to Avici,
